constraint: Accepted offline database is not a safe portable snapshot of a live WAL database. Build a coherent standalone SQL/CSV delivery using ordinary SQLite backup, no source write or financial action.
alternatives: stop source and checkpoint with downtime
ordinary SQLite online backup and independently checked projection (selected)
copy main database alone (negative control; may omit WAL)
cases: post-snapshot source append leaves delivered snapshot unchanged
stop: Run finite cases; retain failures. No demand or profit inference. Original catalog/history transition remains unqualified.
costs: Measure command CPU/wall; full construction/model/host and commercial offer costs unknown, not zero.
